title: Control plane huddle — sketches & action items (2026-05-21)
content:
Date: 2026-05-21
Time: 09:30-10:00 PT
Location: Zoom + #platform-control-plane
Attendees: Priya (chair), Aisha, Marco, Danielle, Omar, Evan (joined late)
Absent: none

Purpose: quick weekly consolidation of work around control plane primitives, routing experiments, auth changes, and quota/refund follow-ups. This doc is a sketch log — contains action items, quick sketches (text), and open questions we didn't want to bury in Jira cards yet.

1) Quick wins / small announcements
- Control plane health: CPU tail latencies on the controlplane manager dropped ~12% after the cache TTL adjustment (PLAT-1987) — observed in staging and one dedicated customer cluster.
- Quotas: temporary soft-cap enforcement fixed (hotfix deployed 2026-05-20) — acceptance tests passing.
- Routing experiments: Canary #3 running, traffic split 5% -> 10% next week if perf holds.

2) Control plane notes (Priya / Marco)
- Cache TTL tuning (Marco): we set per-tenant prefix cache TTL to 2s from 500ms in the manager; tradeoff: slightly higher memory but much lower DB write-burst. Need to validate under synthetic burst tests for 2 hours. Running a soak now (staging-ttl-soak).
- Leadership election jitter (Priya): observed a small increase in leader flaps when pod churn is high (k8s preemption), proposed jitter window increased to 700-1200ms. If rollout green, prepare a changelog entry.
- Open question: do we keep per-region leader pins for Dedicated customers that require strict affinity? Marco to mock a config flag.

3) Routing (Aisha)
- Canary routing v2: introduced per-request cost-estimation to prefer cheaper model variants for non-SLA routes. Initial results show 3–5% cost reduction for internal benchmarks.
- Observability gap: when we reroute due to capacity, trace propagation is losing the original route tag in ~1.2% of requests. Need a quick fix. Aisha to propose a small middleware PR to copy route tag across proxy hop.
- Action item: increase canary from 5% to 10% on Thursday (2026-05-27) if no regressions. Ownership: Aisha.

4) Auth & token management (Danielle)
- Short-lived token rotation: new flow merged to staging, GH PR 712. Token refresh failures under high concurrency still produce 429s in auth-service for ~30s windows. Root cause seems to be a global lock around key rotation.
- Short-term mitigation: exponential backoff + local in-memory cache for 60s. Long-term: remove global rotation lock and switch to shard-based locks (PLAT-2040). Danielle to scope shard count and an estimate for rollout.
- Compliance: audit log formatting changed; SRE asked for iso8601 instead of epoch in payloads. Danielle to coordinate change with observability team and push a minor schema bump.

5) Quotas & billing reconciliation (Omar)
- Refund queue: stuck items reduced but some backpressure remains due to DB index contention on refunds table. Proposed: add a composite index (customer_id, created_at) and paginate processing to reduce lock time. Omar to open quick migration PR and schedule a 10-minute maintenance window for one small shard.
- Quota enforcement: we softened hard-stop for experimental customers; need a promo notice in Console. Omar to draft messaging for Product and Growth.

6) Blockers / escalations
- Load test failure on large model load (Evan): when >6 concurrent large-model loads into the runtime, control plane reports intermittent 502s. Might be related to KV cache eviction timing. Evan to pair with serving-runtime team tomorrow.
- DB migration gating: planned migration for refunds index requires freeze on schema-changing PRs. Marco to coordinate freeze window and notify teams.

7) Decisions made
- Increase leader jitter window to 700-1200ms (agreed) — rollout via small config toggle and feature flag for dedicated customers. (Priya)
- Deploy cache TTL change to production after 24h soak in staging if no >5% error rate. (Marco)

8) Action items (owner / ETA)
- Marco: finish staging soak report for TTL change and post to #platform-control-plane (2026-05-22)
- Aisha: open middleware PR to preserve route tags across proxy hop and increase canary to 10% if pass (2026-05-27)
- Danielle: propose shard-based key rotation design doc + estimate (2026-05-24)
- Omar: open refund-table index migration PR and propose a 10-minute shard maintenance window (2026-05-23)
- Evan: sync with serving-runtime on KV eviction timing and test with controlled model-loading (2026-05-22)
- Priya: draft changelog entry for leader jitter and coordinate rollout (2026-05-23)

9) Notes to self / follow-ups (informal)
- We should add a little “post-mortem-lite” template for short incidents that hit Dedicated customers — keep it to 2–3 bullets + actions. (Priya)
- Keep an eye on the cost regression metric after canary increases. If cost reduction stalls but latency worsens, roll back quickly. (Aisha)

10) Links + refs
- TTL soak dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ttl-soak
- GH PR (auth token rotation): https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/712
- Jira cards: PLAT-1987 (cache TTL), PLAT-2040 (key rotation sharding)

Next sync: weekly huddle same time next Thursday (2026-05-28) unless major blocker prompts an ad-hoc.

End of notes — please add comments inline or ping Priya for anything I missed.
